hook.name: RobinhoodV4SingleVaultHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook (RobinhoodV4SingleVaultHook) that charges a flat 1.5% fee (FEE_BPS=150) on payment-token (non-launch token) swaps, minting the fee as ERC-6909 claims to a single per-pool claimRecipient. Pool registration is restricted to the factory and liquidity additions to the position manager. No creator tax or fee split.
